name: What is the typical timeline for a pool landscaping project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a pool landscaping project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a pool landscaping project can range from a few weeks to several months, depending on its complexity and scale. Smaller projects involving only planting or minor hardscaping might be completed in 2-4 weeks. More extensive projects, which include significant demolition, new patio installation, outdoor kitchens, or custom water features, could take 6-12 weeks or longer. Design and permitting (if required) can add several weeks before physical work begins. Weather conditions, especially extreme heat in Las Vegas, can also influence the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pool landscaping project can take anywhere from a few weeks for minor updates to several months for complex designs, with additional time for design and permitting.
